info.tactics: The Croupier is a tricky mid-range fighter that forces enemies to choose between their attack rolls and their health. Croupiers work especially well against enemies that make many attacks, but they have fewer options against armor, control effects, and forced saves.
info.terse: Tricky mid-range striker that punishes attack rolls.

on_crit.detail: Target becomes Impaired until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Jinx
actions.detail: Make a tech attack against a character within Sensors. On a hit, until the end of the target's next turn, when they succeed on an attack, they must choose one: they take {3/4/5} Explosive, or they reroll and keep the second result.

add_special.detail: When you succeed on an attack, choose one: take {3/4/5} Explosive, or reroll and keep the second result. This effect triggers only once per attack roll.

name: Fifty-Fifty
effect: The Croupier is Invisible until it takes damage. It regains Invisible at the start of the next round.

active_effects.name: Fifty-Fifty
active_effects.detail: You are Invisible until you take damage. You regain Invisible at the start of the next round.

actions.name: Stack the Odds
actions.detail: Make a tech attack against a character within Sensors. On a hit, until the end of the target's next turn, whenever they make an attack and the final result of their roll is odd, the attack's highest damage value is reduced by {3/4/5}.

add_special.detail: When you make an attack and the final result of your roll is odd, the attack's highest damage value is reduced by {3/4/5}.

deployables.name: Loaded Die
deployables.detail: Toss a loaded die onto a free space within Sensors. Hostile characters within Burst 2 of the die suffer the effect of Jinx until they leave the area.

add_special.detail: When you succeed on an attack, choose one: take {3/4/5} Explosive, or reroll and keep the second result. This effect triggers only once per attack roll.

actions.name: Big Blind
actions.trigger: A character within Range 10 takes a free action or reaction.
actions.detail: You interrupt the triggering character, attacking them with the Bandit's Arm.

actions.name: The House Always Wins
actions.detail: Choose a character within Sensors. Until the start of your next turn, they emit a Burst 3 field of warped probability; they may avoid this effect by passing a Systems save. All attacks made by or against characters overlapping the field cannot result in critical hits.

add_special.detail: All attacks made by or against you or characters within Burst 3 of you cannot result in critical hits.

actions.name: Gambler's Fallacy
actions.trigger: A character within Sensors rolls an attack, check, or save.
actions.detail: You may expend any number of charges from this system to add the same amount of Accuracy or Difficulty to the roll. Take 2 Heat for every charge spent. You regain a charge every time you or an allied character within Sensors fails an attack, check, or save.

active_effects.name: Gambler's Fallacy
active_effects.condition: You or an allied character within Sensors fails an attack, check, or save.

name: Fate Weave [Veteran]
effect: When the Croupier triggers a hostile character's reaction, they must make a Systems save. On a failure, the Croupier ignores all effects of their reaction.

active_effects.name: Fate Weave
active_effects.condition: You trigger a hostile character's reaction.
active_effects.detail: The triggering character must pass a Systems save, or you ignore all effects of their reaction.
